_comment: Vast.ai instance template for StarMiner Puzzle #135 — Pollard's Kangaroo pool worker
_usage: Paste this JSON into Vast.ai 'Edit Image & Config' or use it via the CLI. Set WORKER_NAME to your BTC address.
onstart:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
BIN=/usr/local/bin/starminer
URL=https://github.com/Soumya001/starminer/releases/latest/download/starminer-linux-x64-cuda
echo '[*] Downloading StarMiner...'
wget -q "$URL" -O "$BIN" && chmod +x "$BIN"
echo '[+] Starting pool worker...'
exec "$BIN" --pool "${POOL_URL}" --worker "${WORKER_NAME}" --gpus all
notes: Pool JLP server listens on TCP port 5678 — no extra ports needed on the Vast.ai side.
WORKER_NAME must be a Bitcoin address — rewards are tracked by this name.
POOL_URL: jlp:// = binary JLP protocol (recommended). Use jlps:// for TLS.
Binary is downloaded from the latest GitHub release on each container start.
GPU is passed through automatically by Vast.ai — no extra config needed.
Recommended GPUs: RTX 3060 Ti or better (CUDA 11.8+ required).
